description: Zscaler Client Connector destinations grouped by role/function. Wildcards (e.g. *.zscaler.net) are informational and cannot be directly probed; probe consumers should choose a representative concrete FQDN. Each role carries a `probe` object with the single most-reliable (protocol, port) tuple, derived from live probing on 2026-07-25 (see data/zscaler_probe_results_20260725T022856Z.md). `ports` is retained for documentation of every port Zscaler declares.

probe_conventions.notes: HTTPS probes should be configured to ignore TLS hostname/cert validation â€” several Zscaler-fronted endpoints (CENR proxies, DigiCert CRL, etc.) return tenant or shared certs that will not match the request hostname.
